question: What is the meaning of energy consumption in relation to sustainability features?
description: Energy consumption in relation to sustainability features refers to the amount of energy used during the lifecycle of a building or construction project. It is a key parameter that is considered when assessing sustainability as it directly impacts the environmental footprint of the project. By measuring and managing energy consumption, sustainable practices can be implemented to reduce the overall impact on the environment and promote energy efficiency in building design and operation.
